description: Test suite for integration endpoints related to Collibra and Immuta within a FastAPI application. Contains unit tests for publishing metadata to Collibra and registering datasets with Immuta, including success and failure scenarios.

methods.name: test_collibra_metadata_publish_success(client: TestClient, app, mock_collibra)
methods.description: Tests successful publishing of Collibra metadata, verifying response and audit event.

methods.name: test_collibra_failure_gate_failure_mapping(client: TestClient, app, mock_collibra)
methods.description: Tests failure case for Collibra publishing with validation error and corresponding audit event.

methods.name: test_immuta_policy_registration_success(client: TestClient, app, mock_immuta)
methods.description: Tests successful dataset registration with Immuta, verifying response, calls, and audit event.

methods.name: test_immuta_denial_access_policy_gate_failure(client: TestClient, app, mock_immuta)
methods.description: Tests failed dataset registration due to policy denial, verifying error response and audit event.
